about.title: About Athar Accounting
about.text: Athar Accounting is a cloud accounting system built specifically for the Arab business environment, aimed at simplifying day-to-day accounting work for business owners and accountants alike. The system is designed to cover the full workflow of any business or group of companies: from the accounting foundation (chart of accounts and daily journal entries), through sales, purchases, inventory and fixed assets, to managing employees, their payroll and entitlements. With full support for ZATCA-compliant e-invoicing for Saudi companies, and accurate financial reports that reflect the true picture of business performance at any moment, in each company's own currency and country.

why.title: Designed to fit the way you work

items.title: ZATCA compliant (Saudi companies)
items.desc: Electronic tax invoices (standard and simplified) with a real QR code, built from the ground up to meet the requirements of the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority — enabled automatically for any company that selects Saudi Arabia as its country.

items.title: A whole group in one place
items.desc: Manage all your companies from a single screen, with complete data separation per company and consolidated reports for the whole group.

items.title: A complete employee lifecycle
items.desc: From hiring and leave to payroll and end-of-service benefits, calculated automatically per the applicable labor system.

items.title: Instant financial reports
items.desc: The trial balance, income statement and balance sheet update live with every entry and invoice you record.

items.title: Integrated sales and purchases cycle
items.desc: From quotation to invoice to receipt, and from purchase order to supplier invoice, with full automatic accounting links.

items.title: An interface designed for your market
items.desc: Built from scratch to fit how accountants in the Arab market actually work, not an interface translated from a foreign system.
